# atproto_tangled_repository_collaborator (Resource)

Grants an account push access to a repository. The provider's account must own the repository.

The knot must advertise the `knot-acl` capability.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "atproto_tangled_repository_collaborator" "bob" {
  knot     = atproto_tangled_repository.site.knot
  repo_did = atproto_tangled_repository.site.repo_did
  subject  = data.atproto_account.bob.did
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `knot` (String) Domain of the knot.
- `repo_did` (String) DID of the repository, the `repo_did` of an `atproto_tangled_repository`.
- `subject` (String) DID of the account.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifying attributes joined with `/`: `knot/repo_did/subject`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# knot/repo_did/subject
tofu import atproto_tangled_repository_collaborator.bob knot.example.com/did:plc:repo/did:plc:bob
```
